findings: MATCHED_FLATNESS imports the regular seed-domain theorem; that theorem invokes Supplemental generic-flatness and localization.

Supplemental generic-flatness proves a universal cubic norm identity through irreducibility/dominance, citing Bondal--Zhdanovskiy dimension results and semialgebraic Hardt triviality; the final passage to entrywise flatness uses row Gram sums and AM-GM.

The repository README explicitly limits exact_lower_block_specialization.py to nonempty regular localization and exclusion of the plus matching. It explicitly does not present it as a four-variable characteristic-zero normal-form proof.

Therefore the specialization certificate alone cannot discharge universal matched existence in Lean. The dimension/dominance proof still needs formalization, or an exact universal algebraic identity with its existing reconstruction bindings needs a kernel-checked proof.
The already checked DenseExistence.matchedExistence_of_dense supplies the final topological extension, but does not supply existence on the dense set.
scope: Read-only review of mathematical dependencies. No atlas certificates executed or adopted.
